title: sparkxray simulation
description: A run's time split between the driver and the executors, its reference times and core-hours, and its estimated wall time at other executor counts, as sparkxray executors simulate LOG --json prints it. Each group of jobs that ran together is replayed onto executors times cores task slots, every task taking the run time it took, as Sparklens's model replays them, and the time no job ran is held at every count. The reference times and the model's check use the log's executors and cores. A field is null where the log names no executor's cores. A field removed or a meaning changed raises schema_version, and a field added does not.

generated_by.description: The sparkxray version that wrote it, as `sparkxray 0.12.0`.

wall_ms.description: The run's wall time, from the application's start to its end, or to the last thing the log saw finish.

executor_count.description: The most executors alive at once. In local mode the driver runs the tasks, and counts as the one executor.

executor_core_count.description: Each executor's cores in the log: those of the resource profile most executors ran under.

core_count.description: The run's cores: executor_count times executor_core_count.

resource_profile_id.description: The resource profile executor_core_count came from.

resource_profile_count.description: How many resource profiles the executors ran under.

job_group_count.description: The groups of jobs the model replays, each the jobs of one SQL execution or of overlapping spans.

overlap_merge_count.description: How many times a group starting before the groups ahead of it had ended merged into them, so jobs a thread pool ran at once replay at once.

task_run_ms.description: The run time of every task the model replays: each partition's first success across its stage's attempts.

retry_run_ms.description: The run time of every other task attempt, failed, killed or speculative, which the model does not replay.

driver_ms.description: The time no job ran: wall_ms less executor_ms.

executor_ms.description: The time some job ran: the job groups' spans, from each group's first job submitted to its last ended.

critical_path_ms.description: The run on unlimited executors: driver_ms plus each group's longest chain of stages, each stage costing its longest task.

perfect_parallel_ms.description: The run at today's size with no skew: driver_ms plus task_run_ms over core_count.

single_core_ms.description: The run on one core: driver_ms plus task_run_ms.

model_estimate_ms.description: The model's estimate at the run's own executor_count and executor_core_count.

model_error_share.description: How far model_estimate_ms is from wall_ms, over wall_ms. A large error, often from dynamic allocation, says the curve deserves less trust.

executor_lifetime_core_hours.description: Each executor's cores over its own lifetime, which counts an executor added or removed partway through for the time it lived.

driver_wasted_core_hours.description: core_count over driver_ms, the cores no job could use.

executor_wasted_core_hours.description: core_count over executor_ms, less used_core_hours: the cores inside jobs that no task held.

curve_executor_core_count.description: Each executor's cores in the curve: --cores where given, or executor_core_count.

curve.description: One point a distinct executor count, fewest first.

utilization_share.description: task_run_ms over the pool's core time, estimated_wall_ms times executor_count times curve_executor_core_count.

core_hours.description: The pool's core time at that count.

dpu_hours.description: core_hours over 4, the vCPUs of a Glue DPU. Null off Glue.
